summary.text: Donald P. (Don) Wagner is the Republican nominee and an Orange County Supervisor, a former mayor of Irvine and member of the California Assembly. He proposes requiring voter ID at the polls and returning mail ballots by Election Day.

paragraphs.text: Wagner holds a B.A. in English from the University of California, Los Angeles, and a J.D. from the University of California, Hastings, and works as an attorney.
His candidate statement also lists service as a business owner.
He served in the California State Assembly from 2010 to 2016 and as Mayor of Irvine from 2016 to 2019.
He has represented District 3 on the Orange County Board of Supervisors since 2019.
